textBroker: This adapter runs its own MQTT broker. Point the faikout modules at it; nothing else is needed.
helpPort: Port the broker listens on. Must differ from any other MQTT broker (e.g. the mqtt adapter).
helpUser: Leave empty to accept connections without authentication.
helpPass: Only used when a user name is set.
textSetup: Open the module's web interface, go to Settings, tab Basic, and set 'MQTT host' to <ioBroker IP>:<port above>. The module reconnects on its own.
textDocker: The broker port must be published by the container, otherwise the modules cannot reach it. Add a port mapping for the port configured above.
textLive: By default a module reports its status every 60 seconds ('reporting'), so a command is confirmed only with the next report. Enabling 'livestatus' in the module's Extra settings makes it report immediately.
textConsumption: The units only report lifetime counters. The adapter derives hourly and daily consumption from them (consumption.*), keeps the totals unchanged (status.*) and stores the last 48 hours as JSON for the widget.
labelHistoryRegister: Log consumption with the history adapter
helpHistoryRegister: Registers the consumption data points for recording automatically, so charts work without configuring each point by hand.
headerModule: Settings in the faikout module for the complete set of data points
textModule: Which data points appear depends on settings in the faikout module itself (web interface of the module, Settings; most of them under Advanced; older firmware spells them without the dot, e.g. 'haenable'). Nothing has to be set here in the adapter.
setOtherNo: other no.* (econo, powerful, comfort, streamer, quiet, sensor, swingv, swingh, flap, antifreeze)
effMqttHost: Connects the module to this adapter's broker.
effHaEnable: Required. Only with it does the module publish its readings (temperatures, mode, energy …); without it only diagnostics arrive and the adapter logs a warning.
effFanRpm: Fan speed (status.fanfreq) in rpm instead of Hz. The adapter detects the unit itself; rpm is more precise.
effCompRpm: Compressor speed (status.comp) in rpm instead of Hz. The adapter detects the unit itself.
effSwitches: Adds status.autoe, the main switch of the module's own automation.
effHvacAction: Adds status.action: what the unit is actually doing (heating, cooling, idle, defrosting …).
effHumidity: Humidity status.hum. Switch it on only if the unit has no humidity sensor.
effLed: LED control control.led - only if the unit's display LED can be switched.
effHumidify: Humidifier control control.humidify - only for units with a humidifier.
effOtherNo: Each one hides the matching function. Switch on only for functions your unit really lacks.
effLivestatus: Reports immediately instead of every 'reporting' seconds, so commands are confirmed within about a second.
effReporting: Interval of the periodic report in seconds.
textModuleNoSetting: No setting is needed for energy counters, power draw, compressor and fan speed, refrigerant and outside temperature: the module reads them from the unit on its own. Whether they appear depends only on the model.
